name: paper-b1r-v1
description: B1-revisit in paper-protocol mode: paper-b0-v1 plus revisit (a candidate given up for a motion reason - approach_no_path, approach_timeout, approach_goal_reached_far, approach_stuck - is eligible again after cooldown_steps and once the robot is min_moved_m away, at most max_revisits times; in EXPLORE a confirmed candidate within the stop distance goes straight to FACE/VERIFY/STOP). cooldown 30 steps replaces the lockstep 30 s.
